pages.title: Vacuum State Projector
pages.text: A projector that changes what empty space is. Exotic matter in its core shifts the vacuum energy of the region it covers, so the field inside is a slightly different universe. The edge of the effect shimmers.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The vacuum is not unique; there are many possible ground states. Feeding Exotic Matter Crystal into the projector stack let me nudge a region into a neighbouring one, briefly and safely.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Horizon Simulation.
